The authorities, I learnt, were dissatisfied with our Lieutenant Colonel.
In fact, his enemies were preparing a surprise for him.
And then the commander of the division arrived and kicked up the Devil of Ashindi.
Shortly afterwards, he was ordered to retire.
I won't tell you how it all happened.
Suddenly, there was a marked coolness in the town towards him and all his family.
His friends all turned their backs on him.
Then I took my first step.
I met Agafiya Ivanovna, with whom I'd always kept up a friendship and said, do you know
there's a deficit of 4,500 rubles of government money in your father's accounts?
